limits: Network and marked slow engine tests were excluded.
OCR, Chronos, actual copy-number correction and specialized screen adapters are not implemented.
No 100% interpretation, universal-screen or biological-superiority claim is supported.
Earlier reruns replaced database result rows. The run-history migration prevents that for future executions; missing historical rows were not reconstructed.
Raw benchmark uses library A; author processed counts use A+B and are normalized, so these are separate test inputs.
